newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 1997 inflation seen below 4 pct - Negara.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 1997 inflation seen below 4 pct - Negara.

text.p: Malaysia's inflation rate in 1997 is expected to be contained below four percent, Bank Negara said in its 1996 annual report on Friday.
Inflation, as measured by the Consumer Price Index, grew by 3.5 percent in 1996, mainly fuelled by food price rises, the central bank report said.

"The moderate increase in prices during 1996 also reflected low import prices as a result of low inflation abroad, the appreciation of the ringgit and the abolition of import duties on a wide range of items in the 1996 budget," it said.
